audit.why: Mobile melee bruiser with a chained dash off every cast (Drakehound's Step, P). She contests the early levels; Aatrox needs her Repudiation (W) spent before he commits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Public Execution (R) is 130/115/100, blinks to the farthest champion in a line and suppresses. Aatrox's World Ender is 120/100/80, so on even ults he holds R for her R.
audit.corrected: Public Execution (R) suppresses on a 130s cooldown and drags you to her. Repudiation (W, 18s) eats your burst first — force it out, then answer her R commit with World Ender.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Repudiation (W, 18/17/16/15/14) shields and grounds — it absorbs your burst window and shuts your Umbral Dash off. Drakehound's Step (P) is an auto reset that chains off her casts: the dash is the tell.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto her. Infernal Chains (W) drags her back to the centre if she doesn't leave the zone, so hold it for her dash rather than the poke. Repudiation (W, 18s at rank 1) shields and grounds — it absorbs whatever you dump into it and denies your E, so bait it before you commit and buy Grievous Wounds for the Public Execution heal. Save World Ender for her R, never a single Q.
